headline: Expiry‑day trades are costing you

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: Across 90 expiry‑day trades you lost ₹1,16,891, averaging a loss of ₹1,299 per trade with a 29% win rate and a 28% loss on average. By contrast, the remaining 124 trades posted a smaller average loss of ₹449, a 5% loss overall and a 37% win rate.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: You may want to apply this rule in the next review period.
